name: Hiura Azusa
source:
Azusa is a first year student at Shintoku who is popular for his good looks, even attracting the admiration of two upperclassmen who act as his bodyguards. He is also typically in the company of Kinoshita Mayumi, who is usually seen quietly following Azusa around and carrying his things for him. Though Azusa appears as a cheerful and personable person on the outside, he is actually fastidious, haughty, and when he dislikes someone, he hates them from the bottom of his heart. He is also very gullible and often believes in other's superficial appearances, never thinking that they may also be two-sided like he is, giving him a sort of childish innocence to his personality. He idolizes Kaneko Mitsunobu, his upperclassman, and tries to find excuses to be around him.
